import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (possible commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''))
    # Keep only needed columns (id is kept as required)
    return df[['penguin_id', 'species', 'body_mass_g']]

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
